notes: Read-only Python pipeline. D3 re-uses D2's funding history, R4C's corrected fee matrix, and R4's per-event swap data (all already on disk).
D3 does NOT re-pull on-chain data. D3 does NOT touch wallets, signers, broadcasters, MEV submitters, or store adapters.

D3 does NOT place any orders. The hedge is a theoretical model assumption, not a real trade.

No chain state mutations: this stage produced CSVs/JSONL/MD only.
No LP, swap, approve, collect, mint, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, bridge, or signing call was attempted.
Freeze preserved: no canary, no live, no paper, no mode B, no R1/R2/R3/R4 long-horizon collector restart, no wallet instantiation.
Per user policy: no auto-exit engineering was written; no tiny live probe was started; no live/canary/paper.

D2's GO_DELTA_HEDGED_LP_PLAN_ONLY was upgraded to GO_DELTA_HEDGED_REWARD_LP_PLAN_ONLY because: (1) DefiLlama's 63.52% AERO reward APR was observed, (2) the reward thickens the edge by 22% on the same cell, (3) the edge is robust to funding stress and reward scenario, (4) min viable capital is $250 (well below $1000).
